data.title: Forest Trees and Woodland Plants
data.summary: Original low-poly northern-European woodland: tree species and age forms, deadwood, understorey, fungi, rock and ground detail at true metre scale.
data.description: A complete temperate broadleaf and conifer woodland kit built to metre scale with flat-shaded faceted geometry and a single cohesive palette. Species are separated by structure — spreading, columnar, pendulous, whorled conical, umbrella-crowned, multi-stem, pollard and dead forms — not by colour. Every model rests on y=0 and is centred on its footprint.
aiModels: Claude original recipes; GPT-6 via Codex repairs and verification
